result.rationale: In googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts the diff wraps refresh in refreshOAuthTokens, which (per refreshOAuthTokens.ts) returns a raw `fetch` Response when credential sync is enabled, then does `const token = res?.data` — the Axios-only property — so in the sync path `token` is undefined and subsequent access to token.access_token fails/discards the refreshed token. The mechanism is visible in the diff.
